verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent service documents reminders ahead of annual report deadlines, delivered by email through its Compliance Calendar (docs-3, docs-5). It also sends real-time compliance status notifications once the state filing office reports data (docs-16). That covers roughly half the story: missing for 10: any evidence of franchise tax deadline alerts, explicit per-state coverage for every state where LegalZoom serves as agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the reminders arrive reliably.
